trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the reward for everything else: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, with no task of its own. Work the roadmap in order — story first, the long-tail counts second, and 100% completion last — and this one takes care of itself.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies, in any order you like.
Follow the roadmap: story, then collectibles and counts, then the 100% cleanup for A Long Road.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The very first mission of the game: Jason and Lucia's fishing trip goes wrong in exactly the way a GTA opening should. There is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss — just play it through.
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from the start of Chapter 1.
Finish the mission; the trophy unlocks on the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 sets up Jason and Lucia and ends on the turn that gives the chapter its name. Play every story mission in the chapter; the trophy pops on the chapter-complete card.
steps: Play every story mission in Chapter 1, in order.
The trophy unlocks when the Chapter 1 complete card shows.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 moves the story into Vice City proper and its first big scores. Finish the chapter's story missions and the trophy follows at the chapter card.
steps: Play every story mission in Chapter 2, in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission to close Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 is the Vice City chapter: the city opens up, the crew grows, and the jobs get bigger. Clear its story missions and the trophy pops at the chapter card.
steps: Play every story mission in Chapter 3, in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission to close Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the climb to the top of Leonida's underworld. Work through its story missions; the trophy unlocks on the chapter-complete card.
steps: Play every story mission in Chapter 4, in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission to close Chapter 4.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The last mission of the story, and a gold for it. Play the story through to the end; the trophy pops as the credits roll. If you are cleaning up afterwards, the final mission stays replayable from the mission list.
steps: Play the story through to its final mission.
Complete the final mission; the trophy unlocks at the end credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is an early story mission — a supply run that doubles as a trust exercise between Jason and Lucia. It sits in Chapter 1, so you will hit it on any normal playthrough.
steps: Play the Breakfast Run story mission in Chapter 1.
Finish the mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is the first big heist of the story: plan it, hit it, and get out clean. It is a Chapter 3 story mission, so it comes to you as you play.
steps: Play The Cartel Heist story mission in Chapter 3.
Complete the heist to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a Chapter 3 story mission about family — Lucia's side of it. Play it when it appears on the map and finish it for the trophy.
steps: Play the Child's Play story mission in Chapter 3.
Finish the mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a Chapter 3 story mission — the crew's name in lights, and the fall that follows. Finish the mission and the trophy is yours.
steps: Play the Headliners story mission in Chapter 3.
Finish the mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown takes the crew into Vice City International Airport. It is a Chapter 4 story mission — play it through and the trophy pops at the end.
steps: Play the VCIA Takedown story mission in Chapter 4.
Finish the takedown to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is the Chapter 4 military operation — the biggest set piece before the finale. Complete the mission and the trophy follows.
steps: Play the Operation Savage Glory story mission in Chapter 4.
Finish the mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The gold for doing everything. The pause menu's 100% checklist is the authority: story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and stunts all count. This is the last trophy most players earn, right before the platinum.
steps: Open the 100% checklist in the pause menu and clear every category: story, strangers, collectibles, activities and stunts.
The trophy pops the moment the checklist reads 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts are the game's bread and butter: jumps, near misses, drifts, airtime and spins all feed one counter, tracked in the Stats page. It sounds like a lot, but a focused hour of stunt runs clears a big chunk of it.
steps: Any stunt counts: jumps, near misses, drifts, airtime and spins all feed the counter.
Chain stunts on the long highway runs and the airport straights, where you can land jump after jump.
Use fast bikes for airtime and stunt jumps; the counter is tracked in the Stats page.
Keep going until the counter reads 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: A sampler of Leonida's side life: try one of each activity type and the trophy pops on the last one. The Activities list in the pause menu shows which types you have tried.
steps: Try one of each activity type: fishing, racing, bowling, darts, the arcade, drone racing, the shooting range, golf and the gym.
The trophy pops when the ninth type registers — check the Activities list in the pause menu.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges across weapons and distances, and every one needs a gold medal. Slow down, crouch for stability, and use the range's own rifles on the long targets — rushing is what costs medals.
steps: Head to any Shooting Range and open the challenge list — there are 42 challenges across weapons and distances.
Gold medals need tight groupings: crouch, take your time, and use the range's own rifles for the long targets.
Work through all 42; the trophy pops on the last gold medal.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun runs drone races at 14 marked spots around Leonida. Win one race at a spot to tick it off; the map marks the spots you have won, so you can see the gaps at a glance.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race at any of the 14 marked spots around Leonida.
Win one race at a spot to tick it off; the map marks won spots.
Win at all 14 locations to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Street, off-road, boat and air races all count — but each race only counts once, so you need 20 different wins. The race list in the pause menu shows which ones you have already won.
steps: Enter races from the map — street, off-road, boat and air races all count.
Win 20 different races; repeats of the same race do not count twice.
The race list in the pause menu shows which you have won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is the fishing rival at the pier. Take his challenge and out-fish him: match the lure to the water, keep the tension steady, and reel in when the line runs.
steps: Take the fishing challenge against Cal at the pier.
Out-fish him: match the lure to the water and reel steady when the line runs.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Vice City's arcades are full of cabinets. Pick any game, play it to the end credits, and the trophy pops — no high score needed, just a full playthrough.
steps: Walk into any arcade in Vice City and pick a cabinet.
Finish a full game to the end credits to unlock it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of Leonida's strangers with a full mission strand. His missions appear as a ? on the map; play them through to the last one and finish it.
steps: Play Andy's stranger strand through to its last mission.
Complete the final mission for Andy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's stranger strand ends on the water. Follow his ? missions to the final one and complete it for the trophy.
steps: Play Kenton's stranger strand through to its last mission.
Complete the final mission for Kenton.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy rides alone, and his stranger strand is a biker's story. Play his ? missions through to the final ride and finish it.
steps: Play Billy's stranger strand through to its last mission.
Complete the final mission for Billy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Leonida is full of strangers with stories. Their missions appear as ? marks on the map as you explore. Eight full strands is the target — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them, and each strand ends with a named trophy of its own.
steps: Stranger missions appear as ? marks on the map as you explore.
Play eight full stranger strands to their final missions — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them.
Each strand ends with a named trophy of its own, so track them in the checklist.
The trophy pops when the eighth strand closes.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand is a supply-chain story. Follow his ? missions to the last delivery and complete it.
steps: Play Randy's stranger strand through to its last mission.
Complete the final mission for Randy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand spins out of Vice City's music scene. Play his ? missions through to the final one and finish it.
steps: Play Tyrone's stranger strand through to its last mission.
Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: The first meditation spot — Jason's house, Chapter 1 — is permanently unavailable after Chapter 1 closes. Meditate there before you finish the chapter, or this trophy is locked for the whole playthrough.
trophies.guide: The only confirmed missable trophy in the game. There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida, and the first one — at Jason's house — vanishes from the game once Chapter 1 closes. Sit at that spot before you finish the chapter.
steps: Meditation spots are marked once you sit at the first one — Jason's house, in Chapter 1.
Meditate at the first spot BEFORE you finish Chapter 1: after the chapter closes, that spot is gone for good.
Work through all 18 spots across Leonida; the map marks each one you have used.
The trophy pops at the eighteenth spot.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret wants a one-of-a-kind animal. Take his hunting request, track the beast in the marked region, and bring it down clean — a messy shot spooks it.
steps: Meet Bret and take his hunting request.
Track the unique animal in the marked region and take it down clean.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are tucked into shops, bars and hideouts all over Leonida. Each set needs every card in it — the collection screen shows which cards a set is still missing, so you can hunt the gaps instead of wandering.
steps: Collectible cards are hidden in shops, bars and hideouts across Leonida.
Complete three full sets — the collection screen shows which cards each set is missing.
The trophy pops when the third set is complete.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It spots are the photo-op markers scattered across the state — viewpoints, murals, landmarks. Open your phone camera at a marker and snap the shot to log the location. One hundred of them is the target.
steps: WAiNK It spots are the photo-op markers scattered across the state.
Open your phone camera at a marker and snap the shot to log the location.
Log 100 locations to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's side objectives — stunt feats, combat feats, driving feats and more. They stack up naturally as you play; the Challenges list in the pause menu shows what is left, so pick the easy ones first.
steps: Challenges are the game's side objectives — stunts, kills, driving feats and more.
Open the Challenges list in the pause menu to see what is left.
Complete any 50 challenges to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: A couples' escape: build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is riding with you, then lose the cops together. Break line of sight, stay out of the search cone, and do not let your partner get caught or the attempt fails.
steps: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you.
Lose the cops together — break line of sight and stay out of the search area.
Escape with your partner beside you to unlock it.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three shops, one wanted level, no breaks. Rob a shop with your partner, then hit a second and a third while the heat is still on — if you lose the cops between robberies, the chain breaks and you start over.
steps: Rob a shop with your partner, then hit a second and a third without losing your wanted level.
Keep the heat on between robberies — do not lose the cops or the chain breaks.
The third robbery in a row, still wanted, unlocks the trophy.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Every new vehicle you drive gets logged in the vehicle catalogue — cars, bikes, boats, planes and trucks all count. Drive everything you see; the catalogue in the pause menu shows how many you have found.
steps: Every new vehicle you drive is logged in the vehicle catalogue.
Drive 100 different vehicles — cars, bikes, boats, planes and trucks all count.
The catalogue in the pause menu shows how many you have found.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time and lets you pick targets one by one. The trick is the setup: gather five enemies in one spot first, then trigger it and drop all five before it ends. Crowded gang hideouts are the easiest place to line five up.
steps: Combat Focus slows time and lets you pick targets.
Gather five enemies in one spot, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it ends.
Crowded gang hideouts are the easiest place to line five up.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: VCIA is Vice City International Airport. Get onto the tarmac, steal a plane, and take off without a flight plan — an unscheduled departure, in the tower's words.
steps: Head to VCIA airport and steal a plane without a flight plan.
Take off and leave the airport airspace to unlock it.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhinos are the army's tanks, and they show up at the military base and in high-wanted-level responses. Survive the encounter — steal one, or destroy it — and the trophy pops.
steps: Rhino tanks appear at the military base and in high-wanted-level responses.
Survive the encounter — steal one or destroy it to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A clean jewelry job: case the store first — cameras, guards and the alarm panel — then rob it without being detected. Silent takedowns, no alarms, no witnesses.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and case it first: cameras, guards and the alarm panel.
Rob it without being detected — silent takedowns and no alarms.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults are the big scores: each one needs planning, a crew and a clean getaway. Five different vaults across Leonida is the target, and every one has to end in an escape.
steps: Bank vaults are the big scores — each needs planning, a crew and a clean getaway.
Rob five different bank vaults across Leonida.
Escape after each one; the trophy pops after the fifth clean getaway.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks run set routes around Vice City. Hit one, crack it open, grab the cash — then escape the responding cops. A sticky bomb on the rear doors opens the truck fast.
steps: Armored trucks run set routes around Vice City.
Hit a truck, crack it open and grab the cash.
Escape the responding cops to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Leonida has 52 named areas, and the map fills in as you visit each one. Drive, sail or fly through every corner; the map's fog lifts as you go, and the map checklist shows the areas you still have not touched.
steps: Leonida has 52 named areas — the map fills in as you visit each one.
Drive, sail or fly through every area; the map's fog lifts as you go.
Use the map checklist to find the last few areas — GTA-Zone's Leonida map marks all 52.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run illegal operations across Leonida, each marked on the map. Rob one operation belonging to each gang — nine hits in total — and the trophy pops on the last one.
steps: Each gang runs illegal operations marked on the map.
Rob one operation belonging to each of the nine gangs.
The trophy pops when the ninth gang's operation is hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Ocean Beach, a cocktail bar with a view, and a moment to breathe. Head to the beach bar, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view — the trophy pops as you drink it in.
steps: Head to Ocean Beach and find the cocktail bar with the view.
Order a cocktail and enjoy the view to unlock it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: A classic GTA moment: walk into a vehicle showroom in Vice City, get in a car, and smash your way out through the glass. No finesse needed — just drive straight through the front.
steps: Walk into a vehicle showroom in Vice City.
Smash your way out through the glass, classic style, to unlock it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Vice City's lanes. Bowl a full game — follow through on every frame — and the trophy pops at the end of the game.
steps: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a full game — follow through on every frame.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — a stunt or a shared event that gets the crowd going. Pull off a big partnered moment and the trophy pops when the crowd reaction peaks.
steps: Build a partnership moment with mass appeal — a stunt or event the crowd loves.
The trophy pops when the crowd reaction peaks.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices are tracked across the whole game — dialogue picks, mission approaches, side decisions. They add up quietly in the background; 500 of them is the target, and a full playthrough with side content gets most of the way there.
steps: Choices are tracked across the whole game — dialogue picks, mission approaches, side decisions.
Make 500 choices to unlock it; the counter runs in the background.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail a mission or a challenge, then succeed on the very next try. It is the game's way of rewarding persistence — the trophy pops on the second attempt's success.
steps: Fail a mission or challenge, then succeed on the very next try.
The trophy pops on the second attempt's success.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Something strange is out there in Leonida — a UFO sighting, a cryptid, a weird signal in the swamp. Find it, witness the event, and the trophy pops.
steps: Something strange is out there in Leonida — a UFO sighting, a cryptid, a weird signal.
Witness the event to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by: attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Line up a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and bowl them over for the trophy.
steps: Get into a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon.
Bowl someone over to unlock it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from heists and robberies, and they are no good until they are clean. Launder them through your contacts — each contact takes a cut — until $250,000 has been washed.
steps: Marked Bills come from heists and robberies.
Launder them through your contacts — each contact takes a cut.
Launder $250,000 in total to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, cars, food and more. The counter tracks total spend across every shop type, so it climbs naturally as you gear up; big car purchases finish it fast.
steps: Spend money across all shops — clothes, weapons, cars, food and more.
The counter tracks total spend across every shop type.
Reach $100,000 spent to unlock it.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Eight garage properties are for sale across Leonida. Buy each one — the property map marks them — and the trophy pops when the eighth garage is yours.
steps: Garage properties are for sale across Leonida — eight in total.
Buy each one; the property map marks them.
The trophy pops when the eighth garage is yours.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Scooter Bros is the vehicle app on your phone. Register ten different vehicles to it — drive a vehicle, open the app, and add it — and the trophy pops on the tenth registration.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone.
Register ten different vehicles to the app.
The trophy pops on the tenth registration.
